C629  Testis, NOS

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Testis* pages 249-254.

**Note 2:** Laterality must be coded for this site.

**Note 3:** The 7th Edition TNM pathologic stage group is derived from T, N, M and S stage. S stage is calculated from the following site-specific factors
* SSF 13: Post-Orchiectomy Alpha Fetoprotein (AFP) Range
* SSF 15: Post-Orchiectomy Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (hCG) Range
* SSF 16: Post-Orchiectomy Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) Range

**Note 4:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Testis* chapter on page 234 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=234).
